scripts.pods: cd ios && bundle exec pod install
scripts.clean: cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd ../ios && rm -rf build Pods Podfile.lock
scripts.clean:ios: cd ios && rm -rf build Pods Podfile.lock
scripts.ios:old: cd ios && NO_FLIPPER=1 RCT_NEW_ARCH_ENABLED=0 bundle exec pod install && cd .. && react-native run-ios
scripts.ios:new: cd ios && NO_FLIPPER=1 RCT_NEW_ARCH_ENABLED=1 bundle exec pod install && cd .. && react-native run-ios
scripts.set:oldarch: sed -i '' 's/newArchEnabled=true/newArchEnabled=false/' android/gradle.properties && echo 'Android: Old Architecture enabled'
scripts.set:newarch: sed -i '' 's/newArchEnabled=false/newArchEnabled=true/' android/gradle.properties && echo 'Android: New Architecture enabled'
